issues.quote: The current doctor-reviewed series confirms persistent BP 174/104 mmHg while the driver is taking antihypertensive therapy, but the medication review also documents dizziness that impairs safe vehicle operation after the morning dose; although the driver feels better when sitting still in the interview, the nurse has no evidence that the side effect has resolved, and a proposed future dose change is not recorded as an accomplished treatment outcome.
